body.purpose: Panel labels and bar percentages, sized through Style.space().

motion.name: cost-period-selection
motion.purpose: Move the selected period pill along the x axis.

native.measurementConvention: Style.space(n) resolves native shell scaling; values are not a CSS pixel scale.
native.previewSupport: Native component metadata only. No HTML/CSS surrogate gallery or synthesized tonal ramps.

colorFunctions.mix: Linear interpolation of the Qt.color RGB channels, with alpha 1.
colorFunctions.legible: Mix ink toward foreground in 0.1 steps, returning the first candidate with calculated sRGB contrast >= 4.65 against the supplied background; fall back to foreground.

supporting.weight: Font.Normal; Font.DemiBold for warnings and Refresh

native.panelOwnership: KeyboardPanel owns positioning, focus, dismissal and native transitions. Guarded instance Binding objects set the native card radius and color. No packaged shell changes or custom shadow.

components.name: Weekly bar summary
components.description: Two monochrome provider marks and measured-width weekly percentages. Horizontal with separator or stacked for a vertical bar. Stale and weekly urgency indicators accompany the values.

components.name: Cost period selector
components.description: Three equal AbstractButton tabs on a rounded bed; a surface-colored pill marks the selected period. Pointer, left/right arrows and keys 1-3 operate the selection.

components.name: Cost ring and legend
components.description: Canvas ring with the two frontmatter cost colors, a rounded whole-dollar total and USD label, plus named legend entries with exact two-decimal amounts. Missing totals leave the ring neutral.

components.name: Provider quota group
components.description: Provider heading above a rounded inset group containing quota titles, thin shared-accent meters, remaining percentages, reset text and buffer or exhaustion forecasts.
states: urgent or exhausted: urgent, Font.DemiBold and flame
stale: status, fill opacity 0.4 and no forecast
missing or expired: em dash and empty meter

components.name: Refresh and status footer
components.description: Text status beside a pill action; status identifies refresh activity and synthetic previews.

narrative.overview:
Headroom is a Linux Omarchy plugin built with Quickshell and QML. Its visual language combines monochrome provider marks, soft grouped surfaces, clear sans-serif labels, and thin accent meters. The bar is compact; the popup gives the figures enough space to read together.

The native shell supplies theme colors, scaling, and panel behavior. `Panel.qml`, `BarWidget.qml`, and `TintedIcon.qml` are the visual source of truth. The frontmatter records fixed primitives only; native expressions and component metadata live in [.impeccable/design.json](.impeccable/design.json).
keyCharacteristics: Rounded outer surface with quiet inset groups.
Strong headings and amounts, subdued supporting text.
Provider color confined to the cost split; shared theme accent for allowance.
Explicit text for unavailable readings, resets, and forecast warnings.

rules.name: The Separate Roles Rule
rules.body: Cost colors identify providers, the accent measures remaining allowance, and warning colors accompany forecast text.

dos: Do keep theme colors and `Style.space()` expressions live.
Do retain text, units, and accessible names alongside charts, colors, and icons.
Do distinguish missing, stale, expired, and zero readings.
Do preserve the native panel lifecycle and keyboard controls.
Do use synthetic data and identify it in previews.
donts: Don't hardcode the captured blue accent or a captured light/dark palette.
Don't use cost colors to tint provider quota groups or replace forecast text with color alone.
Don't add provider tabs, Extra Usage, or Usage Trend sections to this widget.
Don't put every quota row in a separate card or add decorative animation.
